notes: No study/outcome locators or neutral description were supplied. The named replication primary report explicitly identifies the original Experiment 1 interdependent trendiness contrast as the SCORE focal hypothesis, allowing independent target identification. Original requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed; extracted the printed F without conversion. Original n preserves the printed target cell counts rather than substituting the generic total 47 or deriving a subgroup sum. Original planned contrast uses the factorial-model error term; replication uses a one-way ANOVA. The replication primary report prints both Stage 1 and Stage 2; retained Stage 2 as the final completed stage. Stage 1: F(1, 29) = .025, p = .875, partial eta squared = .001, Cohen’s f squared = .001001. Stage 2 n wording covers both stages, so the sample role preserves that wording; error df 67 corroborates the reported 69 but no n was calculated. The input URL b9rcg is the final DOCX file within the correctly titled sw67c OSF project. Replication title and original paper title verified. Reported major COVID-19 deviation: online Mechanical Turk with photographs instead of a real lab table.
